test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P can run 250 m in 25 s and Q can run the same distance in 30 s. By what distance is P ahead of Q after 4.5 s, if both start the race at the same time?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by P to run 250 m = 25 s

Time taken by Q to run 250 m = 30 s

**Calculation:**

**⇒ **P takes 25 s to run = 250 m

⇒ In 1 s, P could run = (250)/(25) = 10 m

⇒
